children: CDW Canada, a leading provider of technology solutions and end-to-end services for Canadian organizations, has been named a 2026 International Data Corporation (IDC) CIO Awards Canada winner. CDW Canada was recognized for putting governed AI to work within its own Security Operations Centre, using its internal security team as "customer one" to demonstrate the same practices it helps customers adopt.

Canadian organizations are entering a new phase of AI adoption where success will be determined less by access to technology and more by the ability to govern, secure and operationalize it. CDW Canada’s award-winning initiative applies AI to security operations, with governance built into the workflow and experienced security professionals validating every AI output before action is taken. This initiative has reduced the time analysts spend on repetitive triage while ensuring decisions remain with human analysts.
Now it in its fifth year, the IDC CIO Awards Canada recognize Canadian organizations and IT leaders delivering measurable business value through technology.

"We hold our own AI to the same standard our customers expect: secure, governed and accountable to the people using it," said Ginette Adragna, Senior Vice President and General Manager, CDW Canada. "Being our own first customer means that when we help organizations move AI from experimentation to real business value, we're sharing what we've already learned in practice. We're honoured to be recognized by IDC."

This recognition reflects how CDW Canada helps organizations of every size create AI-ready environments. Midsize organizations face many of the same AI, governance and security pressures as large enterprises, often with fewer resources. By applying these technologies internally first, CDW Canada brings practical, real-world experience to customers as they work to adopt AI responsibly and turn their investments into measurable business outcomes.

CDW Canada Corp. is the strategic end-to-end technology partner that cuts through complexity to turn customer ambition into outcomes. Working with organizations across the business, government, education and healthcare sectors, CDW enables organizations to navigate an increasingly complex technology market and turn their technology investments into lasting value.
